pr.title: Unified Storage: validate group/resource in SQL ListModifiedSince
pr.body:
**What is this feature?**

Reject empty \`Group\`/\`Resource\` at the top of the SQL backend's \`ListModifiedSince\`, mirroring the KV backend's existing check, and add a shared integration subtest so both backends are exercised.

**Why do we need this feature?**

Follow-up to #124572. In the SQL backend, \`ListModifiedSince\` calls \`fetchLatestRV\` first and returns early when \`latestRv <= sinceRv\`, so \`sqlResourceListModifiedSinceRequest.Validate\` is never reached. With \`Group==\"\"\` / \`Resource==\"\"\` and \`sinceRv >= 1\` the call silently returned success, while the KV backend rejected the same input — a backend-contract divergence flagged in review by @pstibrany.

**Who is this feature for?**

Unified Storage maintainers and any caller relying on consistent error behavior between the SQL and KV backends.

**Which issue(s) does this PR fix?**:

Fixes review feedback on #124572.

**Special notes for your reviewer:**

- \`go test ./pkg/storage/unified/sql/... ./pkg/storage/unified/resource/...\` passes.
- The new \`rejects missing group or resource\` subtest in \`pkg/storage/unified/testing/storage_backend.go\` runs against both SQL and KV backends and uses \`sinceRv > 0\` so the SQL short-circuit path is actually exercised.

Please check that:
- [x] It works as expected from a user's perspective.
- [ ] If this is a pre-GA feature, it is behind a feature toggle. (n/a)
- [ ] The docs are updated, and if this is a [notable improvement](https://grafana.com/docs/writers-toolkit/contribute/release-notes/#how-to-determine-if-content-belongs-in-whats-new), it's added to our [What's New](https://grafana.com/docs/writers-toolkit/contribute/release-notes/) doc. (n/a)

func NewTestSqlKvBackend(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, withRvManager bool) (resource.KVBackend, sqldb.

block is atomic.
	initMutex.Lock()
	// Unlock once the function returns the initialized backend.
	defer initMutex.Unlock()

	dbstore := db.InitTestDB(t)
	eDB, err := dbimpl.ProvideResourceDB(dbstore, setting.NewCfg(), nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
